value.rationale: The exact coefficient quantifies the time scale of trapping at a degenerate saddle in a concrete regularized factorization model. It refines a qualitative warning about non-strict saddles with a reproducible, non-asymptotic-model-specific dynamical law. The invariant diagonal is selected by the model’s permutation symmetry and coincides with the Hessian null direction, rather than being an arbitrary slice.
